name: Mini Vent Cleaning Brush
subtitle: Soft brush for tight spaces
description: A compact black cleaning brush with soft high-density bristles for dusting car AC vents, dashboard seams, console edges, and other narrow gaps. Its plastic handle provides a controlled grip, while the small brush head is also suitable for keyboards and small appliances.
story: Keep this compact brush handy for quick dust removal from places a cloth may not reach easily. The narrow head can be used around AC vent fins, dashboard seams, buttons, console edges, and cup holders. Its listed dimensions of approximately 17.5 cm by 3 cm by 2.5 cm make it easy to carry or store in the vehicle. Beyond car interiors, the same soft-bristle design can be used dry for dusting keyboards, laptop vents, and selected small home appliances.

specs.dimensions: Approximately 17.5 cm x 3 cm x 2.5 cm
